actions.add-skills: Add the ones I have to my profile
actions.create-profile: Create my profile from my CV

questions: Your agent needs you to answer:
resumeTitle: Continues the same session in a terminal
openTitle: Opens the command in a terminal
stuck: Some runs have been queued for a while and none is running. Is CandidatAI fully open? Close it and open it again from its shortcut.
noRuns: You haven't launched anything in the background yet. On the “Process jobs”, “Assess fit” and “Generate CV” buttons, the dropdown offers “In the background”.
noRequests: No requests. On any agent button, the dropdown offers “Leave for my next session”.
title: Agent
intro: Your agents, what you've left for their next session and what they do in the background. They use your subscription: you don't pay extra per run.

costs.title: Cost
costs.intro: What background runs have used, as each agent reports it. Tokens are the unit agents use to measure the text they read and write: more tokens, more use of your subscription.
costs.terminal: Only background runs count: what you do in a terminal doesn't reach the app. “Instructions size” is how heavy each action's instructions are, so you know where to trim.
costs.thresholdIntro: In the background, “Assess fit” only assesses jobs with this score or higher, so it doesn't spend on those that almost surely don't fit; “To review” says why each one was left unassessed. The score threshold (from which a job goes to “To review”) is {{triage}}; by default, this one is {{default}}.

thresholdSource.policies: It comes from the app's default settings.

jobCost.title: Agent cost
jobCost.terminal: What you do in a terminal doesn't count: there the agent doesn't report its usage.
